title: S4 Revit Model File Naming Resolution Fields

entries.name: Project Code
entries.description: Project-instance code supplied by the appointment, BEP, EIR or governed project registry; not invented by the enterprise standard.

entries.name: Originator Code
entries.description: Project-approved originator identifier supplied by project naming governance or appointment information.

entries.name: Volume / System Code
entries.description: Project-approved volume, zone, system or equivalent code. The enterprise standard governs the token position but not the project-specific value where no enterprise vocabulary exists.

entries.name: Level / Location Code
entries.description: Project-approved level or location code from the applicable governed vocabulary or project code set.

entries.name: Container Type Code
entries.description: Information-container type code from the governed S4 container-type vocabulary; a Revit authoring model is resolved through the applicable model/container type rather than by free text.

entries.name: Role / Discipline Code
entries.description: Role or discipline token selected from the applicable governed enterprise/container namespace or project-approved mapping.

entries.name: Number / Sequence
entries.description: Project-controlled stable sequence or identifier completing the root information-container identity.

entries.name: File Extension
entries.description: Technical file extension appropriate to the information container; for native Revit models this is .rvt. The extension is not a semantic identity code.

entries.name: Status / Suitability
entries.description: Governed mutable metadata such as suitability or CDE state. It does not redefine canonical root identity and is included in a platform label only when the applicable mapping explicitly requires it.

entries.name: Revision / Release Sequence
entries.description: Governed mutable revision metadata. It remains separate from canonical root identity even where an ACC/platform implementation label carries it.

entries.name: Authority Source
entries.description: Reference to the BEP, EIR, project naming register, controlled vocabulary or other governed source supporting each project-specific token value.

governance_notes: Canonical Revit model-file root identity uses SYNTAX-ISO19650-CONTAINER-001: {proj}-{originator}-{volume/system}-{level/location}-{type}-{role}-{number}.{ext}.
SYNTAX-ACC-MODEL-FILE-001 is an implementation/display mapping and does not replace the canonical root identity.

If a required project token value has no governed enterprise vocabulary or project-approved code, the result is unresolved/indeterminate; STAR-T-GATE shall ask for that project datum rather than inventing a code.
Status/suitability and revision are mutable dimensions outside canonical root identity under D-13.

provenance.derived_from: STAR-T-GATE Inbox #10 plus existing S4 naming registry and Confluence pages 11042817 and 7241811
provenance.migration_note: Resolves the routing/required-input gap exposed by Inbox #10 without inventing project-specific volume, level, originator, role or sequence values.
